readout_other: Glasgow Coma Scale; CT; MR thermometry; acoustic feedback monitoring
direction_notes: Case report of a safety event; direction of neuromodulation effect on brain activity was not the subject of this report.
safety_notes: Immediately after the second 90W/300s sonication the participant was found unarousable (GCS E1M5V1); MRI revealed petechial microhemorrhages within and beyond the targeted area, with subsequent hypercapnia, delayed recovery of consciousness, and residual memory/cognitive deficits at 5 months; the pattern was judged suggestive of inertial cavitation.

exposures.label: Bilateral NAc FUS neuromodulation (active treatment arm, adverse event case)

timing.protocol_description: Each FUS treatment block consisted of bilateral NAc sonication lasting 300 seconds (up to 6 blocks), delivering therapeutic energy up to 100 W, with four individual sub-spots per NAc target treated sequentially at an effective pulse repetition time of 3 seconds. In the reported adverse event, an initial 90 W sonication was halted at 89 seconds by the acoustic feedback safety system; a second 90 W sonication then ran the full 300 seconds without a halt, after which the participant became unarousable.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A 44-year-old man with treatment-resistant SUD (Opioid: ~20 years & Methamphetamine ~10 years) with multiple overdoses (~6) and inpatient and outpatient treatment failures consented to participate in the study.
source_quotes.randomised: In March 2024 we initiated a randomized double-blind sham controlled clinical trial of NAc FUS for severe SUD (NCT06218706).
source_quotes.blinding: In March 2024 we initiated a randomized double-blind sham controlled clinical trial of NAc FUS for severe SUD (NCT06218706).
source_quotes.sham_type: He was randomized to the FUS-sham arm of the study which was uneventful, and subsequently had multiple relapses on methamphetamine and cocaine during the 12-week post-sham observation.
source_quotes.adverse_events: Immediately post-sonication, the participant was found to be unarousable (GCS score-E1M5V1) with symmetric motor response.
source_quotes.safety_notes: MRI revealed petechial microhemorrhages both within and outside the targeted area, but no overt intracranial parenchymal hematoma.
